title: The great excavation lay far from the plaza
excerpt: Far from the plaza and in an untenanted portion of the great dead city I had little trouble discovering the foundation patterns of reactive state machines.
author: Camille Dupré
content:
Far from the plaza and in an untenanted portion of the great dead city I had little trouble discovering the foundation patterns of reactive state machines. Walking along the Seine with sketchbook in hand, one observes how architecture and couture share identical structural requirements: balance, drape, tension, and durability.

Form Follows Texture

In both editorial fashion and web software, excessive decoration is often used to camouflage structural weaknesses. When an interface or silhouette is designed with rigorous proportion, very little ornamentation is required.

"Restraint is not the absence of vision, but its most demanding distillation."

We spent the autumn documenting the intersection of Parisian outerwear tailoring and modern graphic layout systems.
